ui.tool_center_rectangle: Center rectangle: click the centre, then a corner
ui.tool_circle: Circle: click the centre, then a point on the circle

ui.tool_constrain: Constrain: click one or two entities; right-click to apply
ui.tool_control_spline: Control point spline: click control points; right-click to finish
ui.tool_curvature: Curvature: click two curves that share an end

ui.tool_decal: Decal: click a planar face where the image's centre goes

ui.tool_edit_text: Edit Text: click a letter interior or outline
ui.tool_ellipse: Ellipse: click the centre, the end of the major axis, then a point on it
ui.tool_extend: Extend: click a curve near the end to extend

ui.tool_fit_spline: Spline: click fit points; click the start to close smoothly, or right-click to finish
ui.tool_horizontal_vertical: Horizontal/Vertical: pick a line or two points to align

ui.tool_intersect: Intersect: click faces or edges to cut with the sketch plane
ui.tool_isoparametric: Isoparametric Curve: click a point on a face (Shift: along)
ui.tool_line: Line: click points; right-click or Esc to finish
ui.tool_midpoint_line: Midpoint line: click the middle, then an end
ui.tool_minimum_radius: Minimum radius: click sketch curves, edges or faces
ui.tool_overall_slot_size: Overall slot Length must exceed Width
ui.tool_polygon: Polygon: click the lines of a closed chain; right-click to apply
ui.tool_project: Project: click edges, faces, vertices, other sketches' curves, axes or planes
ui.tool_project_surface: Project to surface: click curves of other sketches, right-click, then click the face
ui.tool_radius_straight: Minimum radius: it is straight (no curvature)
ui.tool_rho_range: Rho must lie strictly between 0 and 1 (below 0.5 an ellipse, 0.5 a parabola, above 0.5 a hyperbola)
ui.tool_rounded_rectangle: Rounded rectangle: click two opposite corners (Tab to the radius box to type the corner radius)
ui.tool_sides_range: Sides must be an integer from 3 to 200
ui.tool_slot: Slot: click both ends, then the width
ui.tool_slot_center: Slot: click the centre, an arc centre, then the width
ui.tool_spun_profile: Spun profile: click the body, then the axis line
ui.tool_sweep_range: Sweep must lie strictly between -360 and 360 degrees, and cannot be zero
ui.tool_tangent_arc: Tangent arc: click the end of a line or arc, then the arc's end
ui.tool_text: Text: click where the text starts
ui.tool_three_point_rectangle: 3-point rectangle: click two points of one edge, then the width
ui.tool_trim: Trim: click the piece of a curve to remove
ui.tool_two_tangent_circle: 2-tangent circle: click two curves (the circle goes near the second click)
